prompts:
FIND: Public login, OIDC authorize, callback, account, WebAuthn, and logout route implementations
SCOPE: src/, internal/, app/, web/, cmd/
ATTENTION: Determine supported login factors and whether passwordless or direct API login exists
EXPECTED: file:line list with endpoint and required inputs

FIND: WorkOS or AuthKit integration and any provider-issued user identifiers
SCOPE: src/, internal/, app/, web/, cmd/, README.md
ATTENTION: Distinguish first-party Keystone auth from third-party AuthKit
EXPECTED: exact integration files or explicit absence

FIND: Production acceptance test authentication mechanism and reusable saved browser sessions or credential loaders
SCOPE: ops/, scripts/, tests/, docs/, README.md, .github/
EXCLUDE: node_modules/, target/, dist/
ATTENTION: Do not disclose credential values
EXPECTED: paths, mechanism, and human-interaction requirement
